title: Toddler in Canopy Sandbox, Picket Fence - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-1930s black-and-white snapshot of a cheerful infant or toddler sitting inside a wooden sandbox equipped with a fabric canopy awning. The toddler wears a knit sunsuit or mesh romper popular in warm weather during the interwar era. Behind the sandbox is a white wooden picket fence and dense garden foliage with fruit trees. The back shows traces of black album paper mount remnants and a faint stamped production or processing number.
